title: Reporting Data Model
text: {gsm} suite packages monitors clinical trials Key Risk Indicators (KRIs). gsm.reporting sits analysis reporting: takes output metric workflows produces four tables reporting data model.  table YAML workflow inst/workflow/3_reporting. vignette builds table step step runs workflows. inputs sample data gsm.core mapped data gsm.mapping. full pipeline, metric calculation charts HTML reports, see {gsm.kri} documentation.

title: Reporting Data Model
text: reporting workflows need three inputs: lWorkflows: metric workflows, whose meta sections describe metric. lAnalyzed: analysis output, one element per metric containing Analysis_Summary data frame. Mapped_STUDY, Mapped_SITE, Mapped_COUNTRY: group metadata gsm.mapping. practice, lWorkflows lAnalyzed come metric workflows {gsm.kri}. reconstructed gsm.core sample data, vignette depends metric package. Group metadata comes gsm.mapping workflows:
code: lWorkflows <- gsm.core::reportingMetrics |>   select(-MetricID) |>   split(~ID) |>   purrr::map(\(meta) list(meta = as.list(meta)))  dfLatest <- gsm.core::reportingResults |>   filter(SnapshotDate == max(SnapshotDate))  lAnalyzed <- dfLatest |>   select(GroupID, GroupLevel, Numerator, Denominator, Metric, Score, Flag, MetricID) |>   split(~MetricID) |>   purrr::map(\(df) list(Analysis_Summary = select(df, -MetricID)))  names(lAnalyzed) #>  [1] "Analysis_kri0001"   "Analysis_kri0002"   "Analysis_kri0003"   #>  [4] "Analysis_kri0004"   "Analysis_kri0005"   "Analysis_kri0006"   #>  [7] "Analysis_kri0007"   "Analysis_kri0007-2" "Analysis_kri0008"   #> [10] "Analysis_kri0009"   "Analysis_kri0010"   "Analysis_kri0011"   #> [13] "Analysis_kri0012"   "Analysis_kri0013"   "Analysis_kri0014"   #> [16] "Analysis_kri0015"   "Analysis_kri0019"   "Analysis_kri0020a"  #> [19] "Analysis_kri0020b"  "Analysis_kri0020c"  "Analysis_kri0020d"  #> [22] "Analysis_kri0020e"  "Analysis_kri0020f"  "Analysis_srs0001" mappings_wf <- workr::MakeWorkflowList(   strPath = "workflow/1_mappings",   strPackage = "gsm.mapping" ) # These domains are not present in gsm.core::lSource mappings_wf <- mappings_wf[   setdiff(names(mappings_wf), c("AntiCancer", "Baseline", "Consents")) ] lRaw <- gsm.mapping::Ingest(   gsm.core::lSource,   gsm.mapping::CombineSpecs(mappings_wf) ) mapped <- workr::RunWorkflows(mappings_wf, lRaw)

title: Good Statistical Monitoring Reporting
text: {gsm} ecosystem provides standardized Risk Based Quality Monitoring (RBQM) framework clinical trials pairs flexible data pipeline robust reports like one shown .  gsm.reporting package provides necessary functions workflows produce reporting data model used many packages produce visualizations reports. README provides high-level overview {gsm.reporting}; see gsm Reporting Vignette additional details. necessary inputs reporting model created via functions gsm.mapping gsm.core, gsm.reporting generates reporting data model data frames. data frames created follows: dfGroups: Group-level metadata dictionary. Created passing CTMS site study data MakeLongMeta(). dfMetrics: Metric-specific metadata use charts reporting. Created passing lWorkflow object MakeMetric(). dfResults: stacked summary analysis pipeline output. Created passing list results returned Summarize() BindResults(). dfBounds: Set predicted percentages/rates upper- lower-bounds across full range sample sizes/total exposure values reporting. Created passing dfResults dfMetrics MakeBounds().
